newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S DOWNHILL WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S DOWNHILL WINNER.

text.p: Profile of the winner of Sunday's men's World Cup downhill:
Previous World Cup victories: Seven (all downhills) - Kitzbuehel (twice) 1995, Bormio 1995, Vail 1995, Val d'Isere 1995, Garmisch 1996, Val Gardena 1996.

Other facts: Has won more World Cup downhills than any other French skier. Nicknamed Lucho, comes from Alpine resort of Serre Chevalier. Married to a Swede, has two children. Won a bronze medal at 1996 world championships in Sierra Nevada.
